definitions: An ornamental cloth covering hung or held up over a throne or bed.
A covering fixed over a seat, bed, or other object, typically for protection or decoration.
The uppermost branchy layer of a forest.
The transparent cover of an aircraft cockpit.
examples: The four-poster bed had a beautiful canopy.
We sat under the canopy to escape the sun.
Monkeys live high in the forest canopy.
The pilot checked the canopy before take-off.
